exact_module_import.statement: from edlab.substrates.lattice_bond.future_prospective_measurement_bridge import run_measurement_bridge, open_measured_analysis_access, MeasurementSpec, AnchorReceipt, write_anchor_receipt
exact_module_import.verification: the scientific runner must verify each pinned hash at start-up and fail closed on mismatch

constants.name: DetectorSpec.matter_threshold
constants.role: decides cell occupancy, hence component existence
constants.justification: exact midpoint of the admissible interval (absent_matter, present_matter] = (0.1, 0.8], inside which the owned pipeline's own detector reproduces the handed mask bit-for-bit

constants.name: DetectorSpec.min_cells
constants.role: discards components below the size floor
constants.justification: WITHDRAWN — the 'non-degenerate second moment' argument is false (a straight tromino is collinear; centroid and radius of gyration are already defined at areas 1 and 2)
constants.justification_status: WITHDRAWN (W10) — DECLARED CONVENTION carried by its sensitivity set alone

constants.name: TrackerSpec.dilation_radius
constants.role: dilated-IoU term of the association score
constants.justification: one lattice cell — the smallest dilation that can bridge a one-cell gap on a 4-connected lattice

constants.name: TrackerSpec.max_centroid_displacement
constants.role: association score scale AND hard disqualifier (REJECT_CENTROID_DISTANCE)
constants.justification: WITHDRAWN — addressed only the score scale, omitted the hard cut, and conflated a cell count with a displacement
constants.justification_status: WITHDRAWN (W10) — DECLARED CONVENTION; the successor must give a length-dimensioned argument and show compatibility with the sampling interval

constants.name: TrackerSpec.max_area_ratio
constants.role: hard disqualification of an association above this area ratio
constants.justification: WITHDRAWN — the '3 to 9 growth' premise is circular (9 was chosen because 9/3 = 3)

constants.name: TrackerSpec.unique_score_margin
constants.role: decides TRACKING_UNRESOLVED, hence the UNRESOLVED_HANDOFF terminal state — outcome-determining
constants.justification: WITHDRAWN — Part II called it 'not a scientific criterion', contradicting frozen Part I 6

constants.name: cohort_residual_fraction
constants.role: E-2 material-replacement criterion; gates the primary endpoint
constants.justification: WITHDRAWN — restates itself; no principle offered
constants.justification_status: WITHDRAWN (W19/B16) — DECLARED CONVENTION; the successor must supply a principle and a prespecified decision mapping over the sensitivity set

constants.name: backend
constants.role: selects between two engine implementations that differ at the ulp; materially changes the persisted floats
constants.justification: NOT BOUND INTO THE MEASUREMENT ROOT — defect A2; two different measurements can share one spec digest
constants.justification_status: DEFECT RECORDED (W19) — the successor must bind it into the root and validate it

read_not_chosen_constants.note: module-private in the accepted owned pipeline; read, never chosen; they define the admissible matter_threshold interval

boolean_mask.source: m >= matter_threshold — the identical expression detect_components evaluates

cohort_identity.source: advance_passive_tracer integrated per engine step with the scaled gross flows; enrolled entity-locally on the detected components at the enrolment frame

component_mass.source: DetectedComponent.mass on the true float matter
component_mass.note: the tracker consumes a DIFFERENT, binarised morphology; the two are not equal (A19b)

pixel_support.source: sha256 of the sorted linear cell indices

local_intervention.source: FaceIntervention per face (axis,y,x), composable, counterfactual recorded

axis_nematic_bond_order_parameter_Q.source: mean(b[0]) - mean(b[1]), or its entity-local restriction to a component's internal faces
axis_nematic_bond_order_parameter_Q.note: ADDED BY REVIEW. Q o T = -Q under the exact lattice-transpose symmetry T of the engine update, verified to 2.2e-16. This falsifies the frozen Part I 5 'unavailable' row and is the successor mission's central object.

track_to_component_join.source: TrackingResult.assignments — built in memory, never persisted (W14)

signed_internal_state_variable.reason: m>=0, n>=0, b in [0,1]; no state field takes both signs
